evals.name: create-profile-vm
evals.prompt: Create a new MVVM module for 'profile' in the service directory. It should store a username and an avatar URL.
evals.expected_output: Should create lib/service/profile/profile.vm.dart with ProfileModel and ProfileViewModel.

assertions.script: import os; print(any(f.endswith('.vm.dart') for f in os.listdir('with_skill/outputs')))
import os; content = open(os.path.join('with_skill/outputs', 'profile.vm.dart')).read(); print('class ProfileModel' in content)
import os; content = open(os.path.join('with_skill/outputs', 'profile.vm.dart')).read(); print('extends FrViewModel<ProfileModel>' in content)

evals.name: create-weather-module
evals.prompt: Create a weather state management module and an associated API service to fetch data. Put them in lib/service/weather/.

assertions.script: import os; print(any(f.endswith('.vm.dart') for f in os.listdir('with_skill/outputs')))
import os; print(any(f.endswith('.srv.dart') for f in os.listdir('with_skill/outputs')))
import os; content = open(os.path.join('with_skill/outputs', 'weather_api.srv.dart')).read(); print('extends FrService' in content)

evals.name: create-cart-vm-and-view
evals.prompt: I need to manage the state of a shopping cart (items list). Create the VM in service and a simple View widget in the same file. Also suggest where to put a complex version of the view.
evals.expected_output: Should create lib/service/cart/cart.vm.dart with a simple View widget, and suggest lib/pages/cart/ for complex views.

assertions.script: import os; content = open(os.path.join('with_skill/outputs', 'cart.vm.dart')).read(); print('class' in content and 'StatelessWidget' in content)
import os; content = open(os.path.join('with_skill/outputs', 'cart.vm.dart')).read(); print('lib/pages/' in content)
